issues.issue: Can the panel decide exclusion when the Minister does not take part?
issues.respondent_position: Minister declined to participate at the resumed hearing; no Minister submission shown.
issues.result_quote: the fact that the Minister does not participate in the hearing does not alter the right of the Board to render a determination on the issue of exclusion

issues.issue: Did the Government of the DRC commit crimes against humanity during the claimant's service (1993-2011)?
issues.applicant_position: Did not dispute the existence of Mobutu-regime crimes (para 15); no position on Kabila-era crimes shown.
issues.respondent_position: Minister declined to participate; no submission on the crimes shown.
issues.result_quote: the panel determines that the Government of the DRC committed crimes against humanity during the period of the claimant's service

issues.issue: Is the claimant complicit in those crimes (Ishaku factors), so excluded under Art. 1F(a)?
issues.applicant_position: Low-ranking post with no role in the crimes; Sungu should apply, so she was not complicit.
issues.respondent_position: Minister declined to participate; no submission shown.
issues.result_quote: the panel determines that there are serious reasons to consider the claimant is complicity in crimes against humanity
